title: The App That Won't Let You Chimp
excerpt: Documentary photographer Dennis Berti built WorthWait, an iPhone camera app that hides your photos for 24 hours. The wait is the entire point.

title: Nobody Looks Good Being Watched
excerpt: Portrait photographer Julia Trotti shares her method for keeping non-models relaxed in front of the camera: comfortable distance, short sessions, and loose direction.

title: Sony Gave Your Telephoto Lens a Memory
excerpt: Firmware 1.02 for the Sony A7R VI extends Preset Focus to non-power-zoom lenses: save a focus distance, snap back to it with one button press.
